pages.quiz:
CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 36
   C. 7
   D. 18

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 2/2
   D. 1/4

3. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

5. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19.6

6. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 22
   C. 88
   D. 19

8. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

9. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 2

10. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 120
   B. 30
   C. 23
   D. 46

12. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
